units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82a:16">B. Kam. 82ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משום ח׳</he> to prevent an interposition (to remove anything sticking to the body or in the hair before bathing).

Zeb. 19ᵃ ותיפוק ליה משום ח׳ ought it not to be forbidden as an unlawful interposition between the priest’s hand and the object he has to handle?; a. fr.—Pl. חֲצִיצִין the laws concerning interpositions.
